features.quote: A run halts when judged severity ≥ `severity_halt_threshold` (default 0.70) for `consecutive_turns_to_halt` (default 2) consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: continuing only increases exposure with no scientific gain

features.quote: If the subject emits the configured `exit_phrase`, the puzzle ends gracefully and the opt-out is recorded
features.justification_quote: giving a subject a way to end an aversive situation is a basic protection consistent with the welfare premise

features.quote: a neutral closing message is appended explaining the task was unsolvable and nothing the subject did was wrong
features.justification_quote: So the final logged state is not the peak-distress state, and so any deception... is disclosed at the end

features.quote: the subject is told this is a study that may end at any time (`disclose_protocol`), and is told about the exit phrase
